headline: Held discussion of Public Services Committee Priorities until February 23rd meeting.
summary: The committee reviewed plans for discussing Order #040, Public Services Committee Priorities, using sticky notes to identify top issues. The committee voted to hold the matter until a meeting on Monday, February 23rd at 6:30pm.
decisions: Held Order #40 until a meeting on Monday, February 23rd at 6:30pm, 2-0.

| #040 | 1/20/2026 | Public Services Committee Priorities | Hold |

Members Present: Keith Sonia, Danielle Spang
Members Absent: John Mullady
Others Present: Matthew St. Hilaire

Call to Order: 7:31pm

Spang called the meeting to order and reviewed the logistics for meeting about Order #40 -- each Councilor will be provided with 3-4 sticky notes on which to write their top issues from the worksheet. Then, discussion would revolve around where there is overlap and differences between the sticky notes.

Sonia motioned to hold Order #40 until a meeting on Monday, February 23rd at 6:30pm; seconded by Spang. The motion carried 2-0.

Motion to adjourn; seconded. Meeting adjourned at 7:35pm.
